I grew up wanting to be a cameraman in rural Illinois. Whatever that meant. However, once I actually gained consciousness, I realized I loved creating feelings and telling stoires. I became quite obsessed with it. What’s the first step to creating feelings? Well, I don’t really know that, but I assume it’s performances, so I got a background in acting and studied the sh** out of that as well as everything else visual related all before graduating high school. I graduated and skipped the traditional path and moved straight to LA. If there is one thing you should know is when you are at the bar thinking of what to do that night Im across the bar watching my work on repeat.
